text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But... um...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No, no, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's just...
Hayahide's drive was so strong, I don't
really get how I won. My head
feels all fuzzy and
confused...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I felt a similar thing with Taishin before
at the Osaka Hai, but today it was like
both of them
were totally different
people.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And, you know... I wonder if I really
belong with
them.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, geez, what am I saying? I can't be
getting
soft like this!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've been trying so hard to make the
races I run
incredible too—my motivation
isn't any less than
theirs!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to try even harder and
deliver a race
that's even bigger and
more exciting next time!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe that's what you were saying
before the
race as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide! We had such an amazing race
today! I
could feel your intensity!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's always be rivals and keep running
the best
races!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have every right to mock me for
saying this
after how poorly I performed
today, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm afraid I can't see you as a
rival.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin would probably say the same.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wh-wha... But... hold on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why?! We've always run together! We
had such a
good competition at the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
True. At the Derby we most definitely
were each
other's rivals.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But... not now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Not now? I ran such a good race today!
Just like
at the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, Ticket—it wasn't the same.
Something was
very different.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And if you can't even recognize that
fact... then
you truly aren't my rival
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When I set foot on the track, I'm not just
trying to
put on a "great race" for the
audience.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you think good and long
about what
you're really racing for?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait... Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not her rival anymore? And what's
she mean,
"think about why I race"?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I just...
I want to run great races with my
rivals,
and make the audience feel
excited.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Is that... wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Winning Ticket mutters to herself, I
can see
her shoulders trembling a little.
